pitch.text: The hook on the key number: fair is DET -3.0, so +3.5 still covers every three-point Lions win. The simulator has GB covering 51.3% at +3.5.

Independent support on Green Bay: Dave Tuley (VSiN Best Bet, GB +3.5), Warren Sharp (GB, fast dome plus the Alex Moore crew's penalty profile), Simon Hunter (GB +3.5), and a Caesars sharp-action report.

Matchup: Detroit's secondary vulnerability tier is high (Kerby Joseph OUT, Brian Branch on a limited snap count in his Achilles return). Detroit's pass defense is DVOA +18.7% and allows a 62% open-target rate; Christian Watson is the top Green Bay target.
Spread splits: 67% of bets and 73% of money on Green Bay. Saturday's recheck upgraded the side to B at -103 (BEO -107).

pushback.text: Detroit is off the bye at home with the #3 offense by EPA and a 77% red-zone touchdown rate, facing a Packers front without Micah Parsons and Zaire Franklin.
Detroit-side voices: Brandon Anderson (DET -5 power rating, his favorite side of the week), Brandon Kravitz (DET -2.5), Chad Millman (his 'Square' pick) and SI betting (DET -3).
The model edge is only 0.5 point against fair; the value is the hook, not a projected win. The -112 juice on DET says books expect Detroit to win by more than three.
Correlated exposure: GB/DET Over 51.5 is already a leg on both live lottery tickets.
